en.contact: Let’s talk: go to the contact page
en.a2: My name is Lucio Calocero Arcella.
en.a3: I'm a graphic designer who graduated from FADU, University of Buenos Aires, where I also taught for three years. Since 2020, I've worked on graphic design, visual identity, motion graphics and 3D projects.
en.a4: I like going for walks without much of a plan and finding inspiration in everyday things. I enjoy exploring, experimenting, and finding new ways to create and communicate through design.
